name: UserHelp.co
summary: Visual feedback widget for websites: visitors send annotated screenshots and bug reports with browser details, and the paid plan adds session recording, error logs, team collaboration and user forums.
best_for: freelancers, small agencies and site owners who want a feedback button on their websites that collects annotated screenshots and bug reports, and who prefer one payment to a subscription
skip_if: you need documented limits, a refund policy or a support commitment before you buy; or your team already collects website feedback inside its project tool
honest_knock: No refund rule, seat count, recording retention or length of one-time access is stated on the pricing page or in the terms, which date from April 2024. Basic is limited to one project and shows a watermark, and the card does not name its currency.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Pro · one-time payment, use on as many sites as you need, no watermark
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-17 in a browser on userhelp.co/pricing; the card shows a $ sign without naming the currency) Two plans. Basic is free forever: unlimited responses, one project, categories, annotated screenshots and translation into several languages, with a UserHelp.co watermark. Pro is $59 one-time: use on as many sites as you need, no watermark, team collaboration, error-log inspection, the browser's technical details, email chat with users, public discussion forums and recording and replaying user sessions. The pricing page does not say how many team members Pro includes, how long session recordings are kept, or how long one-time access lasts, and neither it nor the terms of service (dated 4 April 2024) state a refund rule.

compare_with.name: BugHerd
compare_with.why: BugHerd is in our dossiers too: point-and-click website feedback for agencies, with Standard at $42 a month billed yearly or $50 month to month for 5 members when we read it on 13 October 2026. UserHelp.co costs $59 once, but publishes far fewer limits and terms.
